description.value: Mystic Market is UVic's main food court, housed in the Jamie Cassels Centre on the University of Victoria campus, with seven distinct kiosks covering everything from Asian noodles and Indian cuisine to pizza, tacos, ramen, and breakfast sandwiches, plus a General Store for grab-and-go items. The breadth of vendors and the campus setting make it a practical stop for touring cyclists passing through the Saanich area who need a full meal or quick provisions. The General Store also stocks packaged items and drinks for riders stocking up before heading out.

address.value: Jamie Cassels Centre, University of Victoria, Victoria, BC

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: building (234 spaces, covered) at 27m; stands (covered) at 52m. Total: 234 spaces.
